definitions.distinct_resources: Distinct (institution, resource) pairs; shared raw resource names are institution-scoped.
definitions.elapsed_days: Last minus first timestamp in original event_seq order, divided by 86400 seconds.
definitions.event_count: Number of accepted events in case.
definitions.max_gap_hours: Maximum adjacent timestamp difference in event_seq order / 3600.
definitions.mean_gap_hours: Arithmetic mean of adjacent timestamp differences / 3600.
definitions.repeated_activity_count: event_count minus unique_activities; extra occurrences, not number of loops.
definitions.resource_handoffs: Adjacent changes of the (institution, resource) pair.

feature_contract.missing_value_policy: Reject incomplete accepted input; do not impute from all splits.
feature_contract.normalization: Strip only terminal (Repeated), (Re-submission), (Correction Requested) in derived activity_canonical; preserve raw activity. This is generator-specific, not a production taxonomy.
feature_contract.precision: Unrounded recomputed floats; originals used 2 decimals.
feature_contract.scoring_scope: complete accepted synthetic case only; not validated for in-flight prefixes
feature_contract.timezone: Unspecified naive timestamps; no UTC assignment or business-calendar correction.

score_direction: anomaly_score = -model.score_samples(X); larger values are more statistically unusual
threshold_limitations: The 5% target is a declared synthetic experiment choice; it is not a legal rule, operational SLA, calibrated probability, or guaranteed false-positive rate.
